name: Integrated Index of Innovative Educational Environment (IIIEE)
description: The transformation of higher education has intensified the need for assessment tools capable of capturing not only isolated innovations but also the systemic capacity of universities to generate, integrate, and sustain educational innovation. Existing assessment approaches frequently focus on individual domains, including learning environments, digital readiness, technology adoption, organisational innovation, or student experience. Although these approaches provide valuable evidence, they offer limited insight into the innovative educational environment as an integrated institutional and pedagogical system. This study develops and empirically evaluates an Integrated Index of Innovative Educational Environment (IIIEE) designed for higher education institutions. The proposed framework conceptualises an innovative educational environment through four interrelated dimensions: pedagogical innovation (P), technological and digital development (T), educational and innovation ecosystem (E), and organisational and human-resource capacity (K). These dimensions are aggregated into a weighted composite index: IIIEE = 0.35P + 0.35T + 0.20E + 0.10K. The empirical study was conducted between 2023 and 2026 in higher education institutions in the Republic of Uzbekistan. The sample comprised 670 participants, including 170 university teachers, 460 students, and 40 representatives of university management.
